translate_en|mods/CigaretteSmoke/42/medi: The smoking animation takes twice as long

Doubles the length of the smoking animation, so finishing a cigarette, pipe or cigar takes twice as long and there is more time to watch the smoke. Nicotine, stress and consumption are not affected. Does not apply in multiplayer.
Play a motion for lighting the cigarette before smoking starts. This adds one action, so finishing a cigarette takes a little longer. Game values are not affected.
